description: Get the estimated average entry price per coin of US spot crypto ETF holders for one asset or all 16: coins accumulated through net flows, money invested, average entry, the latest coin price and unrealised P&L. Also how many consecutive days holders have been above or below their entry and since when. The entry is built from daily creations and redemptions valued at the volume-weighted price of each day; coins of converted trusts (GBTC, ETHE) are not included.

asset.description: Optional asset filter: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_cost_basis
title: ETF Holders Average Entry Price
